definitions.usage: Recorded response/token counters, not unique text, spend or productivity. Cached input is included in input; reasoning is included in output.
definitions.coding: Protocol 1.1 substantive contributions. C = corrective steering; D = explicit dissatisfaction. Overlap is counted once in the union. Not a failure rate or CSAT.
definitions.repository: All-author repository activity over the full study window. No daily outcome allocation or proven Astra authorship.
definitions.privacy: Generic project labels, relative days, no public joins to named source projects. De-identification does not guarantee anonymity.
